name: devwork-copilot
description: Interactive GitHub maintainer copilot with explicit approval gates for write actions.

examples.title: Summarize an issue queue
examples.prompt: Review the latest GitHub issues for a repository, group them by theme, and summarize the highest-priority work.

examples.title: Prepare maintainer notes
examples.prompt: Read a set of repository issues and produce a concise maintainer briefing with action items and open questions.

examples.title: Retrieve maintainer guidance
examples.prompt: Review an issue thread, pull the most relevant maintainer guidance from the installed Knowledge package, and use it to draft a concise next-step comment.
